::: {#rem-wald-test-distribution}
#### Null distributions of the Wald statistics

By @thm-dist-mle, the statistic $Z$ of the [Wald test](#def-wald-test) has approximately a standard Gaussian distribution
under $H_0$ in large samples.
The Wald statistic for $q$ constraints (@def-wald-statistic-q)
has approximately a $\chi^2_q$ distribution under $H_0$.
:::
